figure_goal: Explain the complete current RegionSufficiency computation and the separation of severity learning, paired-view risk estimation, and threshold calibration.
paper_claim: A shared regional representation can be conditioned on visible regions, while paired full-versus-limited predictions expose underestimation risk under the current evaluation protocol.

panels.name: A
panels.content: Retinal foreground and 3x3 region bank with full, center, and center-plus-cross masks.

panels.name: B
panels.content: Frozen RetinaRadar EfficientNet-B0 encoder and trainable regional projection.

panels.name: C
panels.content: Shared masked-attention model evaluated under full and limited masks.

panels.name: D
panels.content: Severity probabilities, 18-dimensional evidence-gap vector, logistic underestimation risk, and calibrated accept/defer decision.

panels.name: E
panels.content: Leakage-control strip: train severity model on train, fit risk and threshold on validation, freeze for test/external audit.

style_constraints: four aligned panels plus one bottom protocol strip
horizontal or vertical single-segment arrows only
no curved, diagonal, crossing, or text-overlapping connectors
frozen and trainable components visually distinct
current paired-view risk audit must not be misdrawn as a single-view deployment head
verification_checklist: Every formula is adjacent to the module it defines.
Full-view and limited-view branches share weights.
Risk target is underestimation of the limited-view prediction.
Training, validation calibration, and final evaluation are separated.
No connector crosses a module boundary or label.
